title: An idea in layers
use: Hidden structure, accumulated work, a cutaway reveal, conceptual terrain, and tactile editorial transitions.
description: A warm, matte stack of irregular contour sheets forms a saddle-backed ridge. The upper sheets lift together to reveal a blue-green layer through a broad cut, then settle exactly into place.
